decision.statement: Close the decision-to-reality gap with a trace contract and freeze a visible historical Architecture corpus before any new peer is built.
decision.reversal_condition: A protocol/tool implementation proves insufficient because repeated execution traces expose a recurring reasoning gap that materially harms decision quality, cost, reversibility or learning.

execution.planned_action: Add a machine-readable Decision→Execution→Verified State→Outcome→Learning contract and freeze 8-15 historical architecture decisions with runner inputs separated from adjudication anchors.
execution.completed_action: Added the trace schema/validator/fixture; froze 12 architecture cases across four repositories; separated CASES from GOLD; added benchmark protocol and corpus validator; integrated both checks into canonical CI.

verified_state.expected_state: main contains a CI-gated execution-learning contract plus 8-15 frozen visible Architecture cases from at least three repositories with adjudication anchors separated from runner inputs.
verified_state.observed_state: Commit 7bb48d5b44a04f1318d4cffda23d9c58236be11a is on main. Verify Peer-Agent Contracts run 33991073714 completed successfully. The corpus contains 12 cases across four repositories and the corpus checker enforces case/gold separation and count/repository constraints.

outcome.target: Material Architecture Decision Discriminator delta beyond baseline R&D + Scaffold + REPO/ENVIRONMENT resources.
outcome.observation: The corpus and execution contract exist and pass CI, but no valid baseline-vs-candidate outcome has been measured. The current evaluator context has seen the GOLD anchors and is therefore contaminated for that comparison.

learning.decision_delta: The architecture question moved from an unbounded build candidate to an executable evaluation program; the promotion decision itself did not move.
claim_updates: Execution gap: partially closed by a machine-readable trace contract and CI validation.
A same-context baseline/candidate run after GOLD exposure would be contaminated and must not be counted as benchmark evidence.
learning.resource_delta: Do not allocate more build effort to a new peer. Allocate the next step to a clean runner that can see CASES but not GOLD.
learning.next_move: Run frozen baseline and candidate outputs in a clean context with no GOLD/source-commit recovery, then adjudicate against GOLD; after visible-train learning, freeze unseen HOLDOUT before any Architecture Agent promotion.
